statute_note: Principal source: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (chain header 'Law Nos, 43 of 1973 25 of 1978 Act Nos, 29 of 1961 11 of 1963 18 of 1965 16 of 1969 61 of 1980 32 of 1986 Gazette Nos, 1386-18-2005'), parsed by build_canonical_statutes.py into a 64-section tree with 14 definitions, no schedules and a publisher's footnote omitting sections 46 and 47. Other sources inspected: the Central Bank 1961 appendix (the Act as enacted, sections 2-48, no marginal notes), used as the verification source; the section index (72 entries); the commencement CSV; every held amending file, whose title pages were read from the scans; the 16 of 2019 Government Printer text. Consolidation cutoff: Act No. 32 of 1986, with Act No. 16 of 2019 applied by hand on top (the header's Gazette 1386/18 of 2005 leaves no marker). Review performed: the opening words of every section searched in the 1961 print, with every miss explained by a chain amendment; last provision of sections 5, 36 and 48 matched, of 8 explained by 61 of 1980, of 29P not in the print (inserted 1986), of 34 differing with no marker; marginal notes cannot be checked against this print, so only 29A's heading was checked (against the 1986 scan) and corrected; validate_finalized_trees.py reports 0 errors and every remaining warning is documented in the trees. Not read word for word throughout. Amendment coverage: 9 instruments known (8 in the chain header plus 16 of 2019 held); 25 of 1978 and the 2005 Gazette not held; 11 of 1963 and 18 of 1965 held only as scans whose bodies were not read (ambiguous_or_unconfirmed); 16 of 1969 and 43 of 1973 confirmed from their held HTML as consequential amendments of section 5(1)(a), spent since 32 of 1986; 61 of 1980 and 32 of 1986 incorporated; 16 of 2019 applied (sections 12 and 20 replaced, 21(1)(b), 21(3), 43(2)(c) repealed). Trees included for 61 of 1980 (rebuilt by hand from the HTML with scan corrections), 32 of 1986 and 16 of 2019 (rebuilt by hand from the text layer). Structural weaknesses: section 31 is absent from the HTML without explanation while present in the 1961 print (the reason this package is needs_structural_review); section 34(6) differs from the 1961 print with no marker; section 29D reads 'section 291'; the 32 of 1986 amending tree lacks the bodies of the inserted 29A-29T; the parser flattens substituted sections 4 and 29L. Section count discrepancy: index 72 = HTML 64 + 8 legacy entries scraped from other enactments in the same Central Bank appendix; the print's extract has 47 (2-48, including 31, 46, 47 which the HTML omits); the tree has 64. Missing sources: Law No. 25 of 1978; Gazette 1386/18 of 2005; a Government Printer text of the principal Act; readable texts of Acts 11 of 1963 and 18 of 1965. Curriculum discrepancy: the curriculum's 'People's Bank Act No. 43 of 1973' is the number of the Sale of State Lands (Special Provisions) Law in the chain; the Act is No. 29 of 1961. Unresolved questions: the fate of section 31; the instrument behind the section 34(6) wording; whether 11 of 1963 (Finance Act) touches this Act; the commencement date (head date 30th May, 1961 used; CSV says 1980-01-01). Lawyer verification: unverified.
